I no longer work in an office (I managed to escape that hellhole and now make much more money without dealing with nearly as much bullshit) but when I look back at my days as a customer service rep for a cable company there's one thing that pops back vividly into my mind's eye: The fried chicken vacuum.

Let me start out by saying that 95% of all customer center employees are overweight or obese. They don't have to actually see customers face-to-face, so they eat themselves into graves and the fact that every goddamn desk in this call center had open candy dishes was a big reason for that. Fucking potluck food sharing every day, nothing but trash in the vending machines, etc. It's like a factory that churns out fatasses. Being one of the only thin people in a sea of blubber automatically means you get glares from all angles, but eventually you just get used to it.

All that being said, this one broad was a step above the usual grossness. She was about 5'5 and probably weighed close to 350. She was in her 50s I'm guessing, and her body had pretty much given up trying to save itself. Her ankles had given out, her knees had braces almost every day, and she used a walker to get from her car to her desk every day. She breathed in a constant whine, like air being slowly let out of a balloon, because her lungs just couldn't do their job any longer.

When we moved our department from the main floor to the basement (which was only half underground, so there were about 5 or 6 stairs that you had to walk down in order to be on that level) she started using the elevator to get down the 1/2 floor. Yes. The elevator. She was the only one that used it and since it wasn't mean for the call center phone crew, but only for maintenance to move big desks and stuff, she called the maintenance crew every single day to come and open it up for her so she could save herself the 5-stair walk.

One holiday shift, which I was working because all the 400-lb chocolate inhalers had been working there so long the had seniority, there was nobody from the maintenance crew available, so she had to walk down not once, but twice. On her second trip down, after returning from lunch with a bag of KFC of course, she took a tumble down the stairs and her howl sounded like someone chopped a bear's back legs off and shoved a live squirrel up its asshole. I thought a fire alarm had gone off and the entire department ran for their lives only to find this tubby EZCheese technician wailing while the gravy from her 4lb tub of mashed potatoes slowly crept out of its sideways container and onto the floor.

As gross as all of this is, none of it compares to the horrific sight of her actually eating. To take a page out of the tumblrina book, i'm warning you that what you're about to read is going to straight up make your guts twist.

So, about three or four times per week this bitch would leave for her lunch break and come back with a bag of KFC that would make Colonel Sanders blush. At least one family-sized box of fried chicken and a pile of biscuits and mashed potatoes as far as the eye can see. She'd eat the entire afternoon, despite the fact that she was talking to customers and putting them on hold so she could continue to stuff her face at her desk while collecting a paycheck.

But she couldn't just fucking eat the food. She had already eaten herself into oblivion and was clearly headed for an early grave, so if she had the decency to just keep on her destructive path and not make a scene, I'd have been able to at least ignore her enough to do my job. But she couldn't

She couldn't just eat the food.

What she would do... I swear to god I'm getting mad as I write this, I'm almost gagging... She would peel the motherfucking deep fried, breaded chicken skin off of the chicken, and put it on her desk. Dripping with grease and salt and all of the Colonel's secret ingredients, this bitch would just pile the skin onto her desk while she gobbled down the meat and biscuits.

She'd leave the skin there, but not without purpose. The first time I saw her do this, I was almost mesmerized by what I was seeing, like it was a parody of a fat person, only in real life. This motherfucking cunt would finish her chicken, biscuits, and potatoes and gravy, and then she'd turn her attention to the skin that she had been saving.

The skin was desert.

She'd take each piece of dripping, greasy ass chicken skin, cock her head backwards, and dangle the skin above her head and slowly lower it into her mouth. She'd snag an end with her lips and then suck the rest in like a fucking piece of spaghetti. She would do this with each sheet of deep fried chicken flesh she had salvaged from the meal. By the time she was done each day her face looked like it was covered in petroleum jelly.

She is the most disgusting person I've ever seen with my eyes, and I had to share her with you. Forgive me.
